items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: My brother-in-law, Jim Lanigan on string bass and Bud Freeman on tenor saxophone

ctx.x: That's it, he showed me a few little things and I started giving a little mugging out there you know. And mugging the face a little bit and oh the number went over great from then on. So that was a nice little tip he gave me.

We did that vaudeville for a little bit. I had gotten the Austin Highschool Gang then. By that time I had Davey Tough, I had Dick Voynow get Davey Tough on drums, my brother on guitar and banjo. My brother-in-law, Jim Lanigan on string bass and Bud Freeman on tenor saxophone and Teschemaker on clarinet and we had Floyd O'Brien on trombone. And we were doing this vaudeville.

So Dick Voynow got an offer to go with Brunswick records to be an A and R man there and to record different bands. So he says well, I tell you what we'll do kid, he says you can have the name the Wolverines and book the band. So what happened was we, I just got my, that was the band. Let me see, oh yes, there was Dave North at piano. On piano and then I mentioned the rest of the guys there.
